Read the manuals as complete volumes or use the chapters in the navigation.
Both formats come from the same maintained sources.

| Manual | Complete HTML | PDF |
|---|---|---|
| User guide: installation, case setup, running and reading tables | [Read HTML](manuals/user-guide.html) | [Download PDF](manuals/user-guide.pdf) |
| Technical manual: interfaces, retained products and indicator extension | [Read HTML](manuals/technical-manual.html) | [Download PDF](manuals/technical-manual.pdf) |

The technical manual includes the complete indicator-module contract and all five set references.
Keep both volumes of your chosen format together for offline reading.
The two PDFs do not require HTML companions.
Links between PDFs may open the volume without jumping to the section, depending on your PDF reader.
Use the contents if needed.
The interactive workflow diagram has a static diagram and text alternative.

Repository evidence, source configuration files, notebooks and upstream literature linked from the manuals
are separate resources. A repository link does not mean that its contents are included in the download or
available without a checkout or network access. Software installation and these manuals do not supply the
external basin datasets. Supported response-surface construction instructions remain unavailable.
